section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports findings from a single study (Study X; N = 509). Drive for muscularity was significantly and positively correlated with Neuroticism and participant BMI, and in a hierarchical regression Neuroticism and BMI were the only significant predictors. Body appreciation was significantly and negatively correlated with Neuroticism and BMI and positively correlated with Extraversion and subjective social status; hierarchical regression showed Neuroticism as the strongest predictor, with subjective social status, BMI, and Extraversion also significant, and no interaction terms reached significance.
